result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a signalized crossing, though the crosswalk markings are significantly faded. The environment is a mix of residential and institutional uses with moderate traffic exposure and lacks dedicated pedestrian signals or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of dedicated pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and traffic signals with 'No Turn on Red' signage, but lacks visible pedestrian signal heads. Safety is reduced by a wide crossing distance and a large vehicle parked near the corner, which creates a significant visual obstruction for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white van parked near the intersection corner blocks sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk entrance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated walk/don't-walk signals to provide clear guidance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but is dominated by wide asphalt expanses and a large commercial driveway for a gas station. The environment is car-centric with significant exposure for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway without a median or refuge.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The wide corners allow vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the gas station entrance.

hazards.name: Commercial Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: The gas station has a wide, undefined entrance that creates multiple conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, leading into the Sunoco station.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signal timing which may not include adequate clearance intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the gas station entrance and define it clearly with a continuous sidewalk level to slow entering vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, car-oriented intersection with multiple travel lanes and commercial land use. While marked crosswalks and traffic signals are present, the large scale of the roadway and the presence of large vehicles create significant visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is positioned in the intersection, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
